product_family: Google Assistant is a consumer-facing AI voice assistant available on phones, tablets, smart displays, smart speakers, watches, TVs, and connected devices. Note: This assessment covers the free consumer product at assistant.google.com; separate enterprise certifications apply to Google Cloud services (Cloud Platform, Workspace) that may power backend infrastructure but are distinct products.

certifications.name: SOC 2 Type II
certifications.proof_quote: SOC 2 Type II certification applies to Google Cloud Platform services, not to the consumer Google Assistant product. Google Assistant consumer product is not explicitly included in Google Cloud's SOC 2 certification scope.

certifications.name: ISO 27001
certifications.proof_quote: ISO/IEC 27001 certification applies to Google Cloud Platform and Google Workspace services. Google Assistant consumer product does not hold this certification independently.

certifications.name: ISO 27017
certifications.proof_quote: ISO/IEC 27017 certification is held by Google Workspace and Google Cloud, not by the consumer Google Assistant product.

certifications.name: ISO 27018
certifications.proof_quote: ISO/IEC 27018 certification is held by Google Workspace and Google Cloud, not by the consumer Google Assistant product.

certifications.name: ISO 27701
certifications.proof_quote: ISO/IEC 27701 (privacy information management) certification is held by Google Cloud Platform, Google Workspace, and specific Gemini Enterprise editions. Consumer Google Assistant does not hold this certification.

certifications.name: GDPR Alignment
certifications.proof_quote: GDPR compliance and data processing agreements are available for Google Cloud and Google Workspace customers. Google Assistant consumer product is governed by Google's general privacy policy but does not hold GDPR business customer certifications.

certifications.name: HIPAA
certifications.proof_quote: Google explicitly states: 'Google is not able to commit that the Actions on Google platform can meet the requirements of HIPAA.' Google Assistant Actions do not allow transmission of information that could be considered protected health information (PHI) under HIPAA.

certifications.name: PCI DSS
certifications.proof_quote: PCI DSS certification applies to Google Cloud Platform services for payment card data processing. Consumer Google Assistant product does not hold this certification.

certifications.name: FedRAMP
certifications.proof_quote: FedRAMP authorization applies to Google Cloud Platform. Consumer Google Assistant product is not a FedRAMP-authorized service.

privacy.ai_training_note: Google uses consumer data to train and improve Google's AI models. For consumer Google Assistant: (1) A subset of chats/interactions are reviewed by human reviewers to improve services, with audio disconnected from accounts before review. (2) Gemini Apps chats may be reviewed to assess quality/accuracy/harm. (3) Users can disable 'Include voice and audio activity' to prevent recordings from being saved and used for training. (4) For Google Workspace/enterprise customers: Google does not use Workspace data to train generative AI models outside of Workspace without permission.
privacy.data_region: Multiple regions (US, EU, and others based on user location)

security.name: Encryption in Transit
security.value: Data is encrypted when it moves between devices, Google services, and data centers using 'leading encryption technology'

security.name: Data Retention Control
security.value: Users can delete activity, control voice and audio recording retention. Audio recordings are not stored by default unless user enables 'Include voice and audio activity'.

security.name: Multi-layer Security
security.value: Google Assistant includes multiple layers of security and built-in security features to protect against threats online

security.name: No Sale of Personal Data
security.value: Google does not sell personal information, including audio recordings

security.name: Children's Data Protection
security.value: Google does not share personal information from children's Google Accounts with third parties (names, emails, voice recordings, location)

security.name: Mute Controls
security.value: Devices with Google Assistant include physical mute buttons and camera switches for user control

products.name: Google Assistant (Consumer)
products.data_scope: Voice queries, device control commands, user preferences, contacts (with permission), location (with permission), Google Account information
products.notes: Available on phones, tablets, smart displays, smart speakers, watches, TVs. Free consumer product. Does not support PHI/medical data. Cannot guarantee HIPAA compliance per official policy.

products.name: Google Assistant Actions
products.data_scope: User commands and interactions with third-party services (e.g., Spotify, Netflix, Walmart)
products.notes: Actions cannot transmit PHI or medical information. Google explicitly states inability to meet HIPAA requirements.

compare.pricing_model: Free (consumer); Premium features available in Google One AI plans
compare.data_residency: Primary regions: US, EU; secondary: varies by user location and service

flags: CRITICAL DISTINCTION: Google Cloud Platform (enterprise) holds SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, HIPAA certifications. Consumer Google Assistant does NOT inherit these certifications. These are separate products with different compliance scopes.
Google Assistant Actions explicitly cannot support HIPAA PHI data - verified on official Google support pages. Any healthcare use case would be non-compliant.
Consumer product is NOT enterprise-certified but uses Google Cloud infrastructure which IS certified. Users should not assume consumer product compliance based on Google Cloud certifications.
AI training: Consumer Google Assistant chats/audio may be reviewed by humans to improve services. Enterprise Workspace data is protected from training use without consent.
No Data Processing Agreement (DPA) available for consumer Google Assistant - DPAs only for Workspace/Cloud customers.
